QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] A Mysterious Guide
QuestInfo.0: A mysterious species calling themselves the Ryuul have arrived to investigate Eluna's power, and one of their representatives, Eremos, has contacted you. What could this be about?
QuestInfo.1: Eremos is offering the heroes of Maple World a new perspective by witch to explore the universe. This sounds like an exciting opportunity, and not just for leveling up.
QuestInfo.2: Eremos is excitedly talks about the wonders of the universe, but most of it goes over your head. His ship is full of neat technology, and he seems to know all kinds of things. He gives you a new title and suggests that you speak with his apprentice Surana.

default.0: Speak to me again once you have reached level 30 and completed the 2nd Job Advancement. I'll be waiting for you.
